name: When should I call a professional for shower drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for shower drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for shower drain cleaning if DIY methods like plungers or chemical cleaners fail, or if the clog recurs quickly. Additionally, if you experience multiple slow drains in your home or notice water backing up into other fixtures, it could indicate a deeper issue in your plumbing system. CG Plumbing Solutions can identify the root cause of persistent clogs, which might stem from issues beyond the immediate shower drain.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if DIY methods fail, clogs recur, or if multiple drains are affected, indicating a deeper plumbing issue.
